title: Compatibility with Android 11
body:
I'm using xDrip with Libre1, MiaoMiao2 and Miband4 and my phone is a Pixel3.
Now, Google is in beta testing for Android 11, and the notification is still coming to me.
I'm concerned about compatibility with Android 11.
I'd like you to check the compatibility with Libre, MiaoMiao2 and Miband4 in the Android 11 environment.
Thank you.
